name: @cyclone-ui/model-selector
description: ModelSelector, a menu that picks one option for an AI agent, such as the model it runs (grouped by provider, each with a short description) or how hard it thinks (effort). It is built on ContextMenu, so it opens as a popover on large screens and a bottom sheet on small ones; the root takes value, onValueChange and open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, and picking an option closes the menu. ModelSelector.Trigger is a small ghost button showing the selected option (with an optional muted label such as Effort) and a chevron; ModelSelector.Content, Group (with a heading), Item (with a description), Name and Separator build the menu.
